drivers.driver: The stock's significant appreciation to a ~30x forward multiple has compressed prospective returns below our 15% hurdle [D05, D07].

final.memo:
Starbucks has been a successful investment, with the company delivering on the operational turnaround we anticipated [D04, D07]. US same-store sales growth has recovered to 6% in Q4, and the company continues to execute on its digital and loyalty initiatives, validating our original thesis regarding the franchise's durability and fixable operational path [D04, D07]. The growth runway in China remains significant, notwithstanding the competitive and macro risks [D04, D06, D07].

However, the valuation has shifted substantially since our initial investment at an average price of $51.30 [D05]. With the shares trading at $91.54, or approximately 30.3x FY2020 adjusted earnings guidance, the margin of safety provided by the entry discount has been entirely realized [D05, D07]. Given current growth guidance of 6-8% in adjusted EPS, the forward rate of return is no longer consistent with our 15% threshold for new or maintained high-conviction positions [D04, D07].

While the business remains a high-quality, free-cash-flow-generative compounder, we must be disciplined regarding opportunity cost [D07]. We are trimming the position to harvest gains as the stock price has outpaced the near-term growth in intrinsic value, and we believe our capital can be more effectively deployed in opportunities offering higher prospective returns [D05, D07].
